widgets.component: 'What is the total cost for 8 practice rooms?' with no prices
widgets.root: Root cause (all lessons): the practice-studio builder keeps each exit-ticket/connect.check follow-up question but drops the shared `scenario` that the questions depend on, so the stem reaches the student with no givens. Fix once in the builder (scripts/generate-practice-studios.mjs mastery assembly): prefix every follow-up stem with the scenario, or render the scenario as a passage above the item. The music-studio scenario (8 rooms, $12 stand and $9 stool each) is absent, so $168 cannot be derived.
widgets.replacement: Stem: 'A music studio orders supplies for 8 practice rooms. Each room needs a music stand ($12) and a stool ($9). What is the total cost for the 8 rooms?' Keep choices and key ($168).

widgets.component: 'Which equation is NOT correct?' with a check-by-substitution explanation
widgets.root: In 43 of 400 seeds the explanation tests a value that makes a negative product (for example 'w = 2 … the right side is -6' for 6(w − 3)), and unit 6 has not taught integer arithmetic (7-1 is the next unit). The hyphen is also ASCII.
widgets.replacement: Pick the test value so every parenthesis stays non-negative (w at least the largest subtracted constant, or only use + sums) and print any number with U+2212; the L4 distractor equations stay as they are.
